metric_integrity: actual_elapsed_sec should be derived from captured start and close timestamps, not estimated from tool count.
active_work_sec may be lower than elapsed due to tool latency; both should be retained when measurable.
overshoot_sec should be positive only beyond target and must not be conflated with close reserve.
actual_idle_gap requires current close and next invocation actual start, so it is retrospective.
safe lower bound is exploratory evidence; operating cap is a separately validated policy parameter.
failure boundary remains unresolved until credible duration failure exists.
workload profile labels are required to detect profile-specific lower boundaries.
load_origin distinguishes purposeful generated stress load from production/user work without devaluing the former.
checkpoint_saved must refer to durable repository evidence, not merely an intended write.
scheduler_write_ok and scheduler_state_ok are distinct: transport success is insufficient if returned state differs.
clean_close should only be asserted after durable close evidence exists.
